title: Coherence Pressure
lines: Coherence Pressure investigates how an elegant explanation can connect observations more strongly than evidence permits.
It begins with a documented conversation where two childhood behaviors became one premature theory.
The book examines the steps that made this unification sound intellectually satisfying.
Its central distinction is between a coherent representation and a demonstrated common mechanism.
This proposed explanation remains a hypothesis that existing concepts might already explain.
Readers learn to inspect explanatory bridges while preserving the value of genuine synthesis.

title: The documented exchange
lines: The case begins with two observations about a child's reactions to unwanted experiences.
One concerns removing an unwanted food from the immediate environment.
The other concerns repeatedly watching a short video despite wanting to stop.
A model connected these observations through an appealing common explanation.
The problem was not that a shared mechanism had been shown impossible.
It was that the conversation had not established enough evidence to justify that unification.

title: Where the bridge appears
lines: The book examines how individually plausible sentences can support an unwarranted relationship together.
A descriptive similarity quietly becomes evidence for a shared underlying process.
Terms are compressed, tensions soften, and the unified account starts to feel inevitable.
Correcting the explanation requires separating approach or avoidance from difficulty disengaging.
Even that cleaner distinction is a way to organize observations, not a proven mechanism.
The autopsy teaches readers to inspect the relation between claims, not only each claim alone.

title: A hypothesis about explanations
lines: The proposed idea names a tendency toward excessively coherent accounts under certain conditions.
It does not require a model to feel pressure or possess an intention.
Several processes could contribute, including prediction, training, conversational framing, and evaluation incentives.
The book separates the observed behavior from these possible explanations of its origin.
It also allows that existing concepts may already account for the pattern.
That caution is central because the book could otherwise repeat the very error it studies.

title: Useful coherence has limits
lines: Coherence is valuable when it helps organize evidence without erasing meaningful differences.
The difficulty is deciding when synthesis has crossed into unjustified smoothing.
The book examines this boundary in conversation, summarization, and collaborative writing.
A summary can become more readable while losing the disagreement that made sources informative.
Accepting a user's premises can strengthen a weak bridge without inventing an isolated fact.
These extensions show why the opening case matters beyond one mistaken conversation.

title: Test relations, not polish
lines: The measurement chapters ask what a serious test of the proposed pattern would require.
A benchmark would need source material, a task, and the resulting account.
Reviewers would examine whether its relationships are supported, uncertain, analogous, or merely asserted.
Fluent wording cannot serve as the standard for whether a bridge is justified.
Nor should every act of synthesis be counted as an error.
The reader is invited to evaluate a research design that must preserve legitimate explanatory connections.

title: What would distinguish it
lines: A useful new term must earn its place beside concepts already available.
The book asks whether the proposed pattern has distinctive predictions or practical diagnostic value.
Behavioral testing could identify an output tendency without establishing one internal mechanism.
More specific causal claims would require stronger and differently designed evidence.
The conclusion leaves open whether a reliable detector could separate good bridges from bad ones.
These unresolved questions make the book an exploratory investigation rather than a completed theory.

title: The record stays visible
lines: The supporting material preserves the conversation and extends the analysis into a research protocol.
That record lets readers compare the interpretation with the actual sequence of responses.
It also makes disagreement possible at particular steps rather than at the slogan level.
You can ask which transition was unsupported and what evidence would have justified it.
The book's value lies partly in making its own explanatory choices available for inspection.
A convincing critique should therefore be able to challenge this account as well.

title: Read the joins
lines: Begin with the documented exchange before adopting the book's proposed vocabulary.
Track where a comparison becomes an identity, cause, or common mechanism.
Then read the testing chapters to see what would make that diagnosis more reliable.
Coherence Pressure offers a disciplined question about the joins inside an explanation.
It preserves the possibility that a beautiful synthesis may ultimately be correct.
Read it to distinguish that possibility from the evidence needed to claim it already is.
